en: I can tell you I'm not enjoying it.
Yeah right. Now look, I know you're older than me, but don't forget, I was here before you. So would it kill you to listen to your senpai sometimes?
(I wonder what's bothering him so bad.)
This one's from a repeat client who came to Fukuoka looking for her runaway son. Does that ring any bells?
(Must be the mother of that kid who wants to join the Devil Killers.)
She's at a rest area.
Got it. I'll head there now.
I'm heading out.
Suzuki-san, before you go!
Just wanted to pick your brain. Know anyone lookin' to do some taxi drivin' work?
Are you short on drivers or something?
Yeah. We have cabs just sittin' around. You're not gettin' any younger, and it's about time we got fresh blood I reckon.
Then you wouldn't have to be the new guy anymore.
I really don't mind.
Either way, we need more hands on deck. Lemme know if ya think of anyone.

(I know practically no one around these parts, though...
Anyway, I guess I should get to work.)
Oh, there you are. Can I get a ride?
Of course. Please come on in.
I know this is out of the blue, but I wonder if you might know my son...
Your son?
Yes. It's been about a year since he ran away from home, and he hasn't contacted me at all...
I'm sorry to hear that.
It's all because I blew up at him for fooling around with his life and refusing to get a job. He was gone the next day, and I've been looking for him ever since.
I've practically searched every corner of the country by now. *sigh* Why does he have to cause me so much grief...
Have you got any leads on where he might be?
The rumor is that he's working in Hakata.
Ah. So he's working at least.
Yes, that was a relief to hear. But I can't just look past everything he's put me through.
I want to find him and give him a good whack on the head! Knock some sense into the boy.
Heh, that should do it. Now, do you know what kind of job your son was doing?
I think he's working at some place called "Street Racer." No idea what he does there, though. It wasn't in the phone book.
You said it was Street Racer?
Yes, do you know of it?
(That rest area where I raced the Devil Killers is always full of street racers...)
Well, do you know where it is?
Possibly.
Great! Then take me to this Street Racer place, quick!
Um, I don't think that's such a⑬
Oh, I'll be fine. Seeing my son work hard to earn an honest living is sure to calm me down. I might even break down and cry!
(I'm sure you will, but not for that reason.)
Now then! To Street Racer, on the double!
I wanna join the Devil Killers! I've always looked up to you guys! Come on, gimme a shot!
Enough of that nonsense talk, Koji! What you need to do is find a job!
Pipe down, the both of ya.
Oh, it's you! Can you talk some sense into this son of mine? I can't let him turn into one of these racer types.
Shut up, Mom! Hey, you're just the cabbie I wanted to see. Let's race again!
Fine. But if I win, you've got to come work for us as a driver. Deal?
Hah! Remember, I already beat you once. There's no way I'm losing today! Let's go!

I'll show you I've got what it takes, Watanabe-san!
Just watch!
Forget it! You can't just be some geek off the street and expect to be a Devil Killer!
But I haven't lost a race since I got here!

So what, you can beat a bunch of losers. That supposed to
impress me?
Koji!
Mom!? What are you doing here!?
I've been looking for you all over! This nice man here brought me to see you!
What the... You're that taxi driver who took us on the other day!
I'm not here for you. I want to have a word with that kid.
Koji, what on earth are you doing here?
Isn't it obvious? I'm a street racer now.
What!? This is what they meant by street racer!? What about your job?
Psh. Who needs a job when I can rule the road?
That is absolute rubbish! You're coming back home with me right now, young man!
No way! I'm joining the Devil Killers!
What do you want to go killing devils for?
It's a street racing team, Mom!
A street racing team? You want to race cars? This isn't like one of those motorcycle gangs, is it?
Well... not exactly. But yeah, something like that.
Over my dead body! I won't have you going around causing trouble for people! You find yourself a job, mister!
I did look for a job! And I found nothing.
Turns out the only thing I'm good at is driving... What company would hire somebody like that?
(I can think of one.)
Come on, Watanabe-san! Driving's in my blood! Let me join your squad!

Man, you are an annoying little shit... But you know what?
Why don't you race that taxi driver there?
Huh? Why?
If you beat him in a race, I'll let you join our crew. Simple as that.
Yeah!? Hahaha, too easy!
I don't think so, buster! I told you I won't let you cause trouble for anyone! Let's just go home and look for a real job, okay?
Mom, this is none of your business. Let's get this show on the road, taxi man!
I don't think so. That would only encourage you.
Aww, come on, man! All you have to do is drive! It'll be over in ten seconds!
You said yourself that driving is all you're good at, right?
Yeah, so what?
I was just thinking. If driving's your thing, you could come work for our company.
...You'd really give him a job?
Of course. We're actually looking for new drivers right now, if your son is interested.
Oh, absolutely! Let's sign him up right away!
Mom! This isn't your call to make! I don't want to drive some dumb taxi!
Why not? You like to drive, don't you?
But driving around a taxi is nothing like racing a car.
Who wants to be some dweeb in the slow lane, following the rules like a tool?
I wanna be a badass speed demon who zooms around corners like a boomerang, burning rubber the whole way. Won't settle for anything less!
How could you say such a thing!?
Say... What would you do if you knew a taxi driver who could pull stunts like that as well?
I'd say no taxi driver in the world can do what the Killers do. Now hurry up and race me!
Watch me win this, Watanabe-san!
Yeah, yeah.
Koji! You be sure to watch out for pedestrians, you hear? And look both ways at intersections!
This is a highway, Mom!
Stupid cabbie! Why'd you go losing now!? Ya tryin' to piss me off!?
I did it, Watanabe-san! Now I can join the Devil Killers, right!?
Yeah, uh... I still haven't seen enough to make a call yet.
Aww, come on!
You take on this taxi driver and win one more time, maybe I'll give it some more thought. Later!
Hey! Hold on a second!
Get back here, Koji!
So what do you think of us taxi drivers now?
I guess I was wrong... You're something else, man.
Heh, just as I thought. I'm outta here.
Have you finally got this racing thing out of your system? Let's go home together. I'll make you a big batch of your favorite stew.
I have to go now, but don't go running out on your mother again. Got that?
Wait! Please!
About that taxi job you mentioned. Is the offer still up for grabs?
Then you'll hire me?

I'm serious here! I'm finally starting to understand why
being a taxi driver might be cool. So will you let me work
with you?

How can you expect that after the way you treated him!?
You think you can just waltz your way into the job world
without even an apology?
Okay, I'm sorry for being such a pain! I mean it. There's nothing I want more than to be a driver for your company. I promise to work real hard!
Well... I don't see why not.
Sure. I did make him an offer, after all. And he looks eager to give this a shot.
You sure it's not too much trouble, even after what he did?
Well, he won't get far acting like that, true.
But in the world I come from, you don't just cut a guy loose once he's seen the error of his ways. Better to let him make amends.
That's... very generous.
I'll look after your son, ma'am. Now, let's get going. You can call me Suzuki. From here on out, you're a taxi driver.
Yes, sir! Thank you so much! I'll make sure you don't regret hiring me!
Koji... My son! I'm so happy I could... *sniffle* Ohh, here come the waterworks...
Hi there. Who's the youngster?
I'm Kiyokawa! And I'd like to be your new driver!
Oho, you're willin' to work for us here? Ya know we're a taxi company, right?
Yep! Truth is, I was dead-set on being a Devil Killer, but now I see that being a taxi driver is just as badass! I'll do whatever it takes to be one!
The Devil Killers, huh...
Kiyokawa used to be a street racer, but let's just say he hit a few speed bumps.

I see. Well, better to end up here than with those punks.
Trust me... That ain't the road ya wanna follow.
(You tell him, Chief.)

You've got yer whole life ahead of ya, Kiyokawa.
How about you show him the ropes, Muramatsu?
Um, I was kinda hoping to train under Suzuki-san!
This guy right here? He knows how to be a real man.
A real man, eh? What exactly's that supposed to mean?
I'm saying I wanna learn everything Suzuki-san knows. He's like... a role model type of dude.

Hmm. Well, if you're that adamant about it, then Suzuki-san,
be sure to look after Kiyokawa-kun here.
Congratulations on moving up the ranks.
What do I work on first, Suzuki-san?
Your manners. When you answer, you say, "Yes sir." Got that?
Heck yeah I do!
Were you even listening?
Oh, for sure!
Did you understand me, though?
Yep, loud and clear! Gotta work those manners, right?
(This is going to take a while...)
You got 1,400 experience points.
Ah, Suzuki-san. Thanks for givin' Wada-san a ride. How'd it go today? Plenty of customers?
About that... I actually had a run-in with these guys called the Devil Killers.
Ergh!
Huh? Oh, nothin'. Never mind.
(Okay...)
The Devil Killers... They're one of those street racing gangs, right?
Yeah. They challenged me while I was on duty.
An amateur like you!? They ought to stick to their own kind... Don't they have any pride as racers?
Well, how'd it turn out?
<Italic>You</Italic> beat the Devil Killers!?
Yeah. Turned out my passenger was a cop named Furumichi, and he asked me to take them all down.
He said the only way to do that was to race them, so that's what I did.
But that's insane...
...I'll say.
Now Suzuki-san, don't you fret over this. I'll see if I can get in touch with this Furumichi fella, too.
Sorry to drag you into this, Chief. I know you have better things to do with your time.
No need to be so humble about it! It ain't like you're the one goin' around wreakin' havoc on the streets.
The Devil Killers... They're the problem here.
Oh, no, nothing. I was just about to congratulate ya for a job well done. Now go and take a breather⑬you've earned it.
Of course, if yer lookin' for more work, talk to Hirakawa-san. There's always plenty of calls to keep us scramblin' around.
Great, then I'll leave you to it.
Thank you for choosing Nagasu Taxi. Where can I take you?
<Color:22>Meisei Street<Color:Default>, please.
(With that suit, I'm guessing he's a businessman.)
Then come on in.
That did not go well...
(He sounds a bit depressed. Maybe I should say something.)
Rough day, sir?
Huh? Oh, yeah.
(I'll leave him be.)
It just could not have gone any worse...
Say, driver.
Can I bug you about something for a bit?
(I guess he was waiting for me to say something. I should've spoken up.)
I messed up a little today at work.
Messed up how?
Well, I didn't agree with what my supervisor was saying, and I kind of lost my temper... so I yelled at him. A lot.
Man, now I'm never getting that promotion... I should've just kept my mouth shut.
I was a fool to fight a battle I couldn't win.

You're right about that. When your supervisor speaks,
you listen. That's just the way it goes.
Yeah... I know... but I can never seem to hold my tongue.
I guess I'm just a big failure...
(Now he's even more depressed... I need to choose my words more carefully.)
I disagree. You have to follow the path you think is right.
...You think so?

Yeah. It's better to define yourself at work by speaking
your mind, as opposed to brown-nosing your way up the
ladder. At least that's what I think.
...Maybe you're right. Thanks for saying that.
(Good. That seems to have cheered him up.)
No one's going to take you seriously if all you do is shout. A real man solves problems with his fists, plain and simple.
What...? Are you saying I should have punched my boss? Come on, I'd be fired in a second.
You need to be a little more realistic.
(Whoops. I should have taken his position into consideration.)
